successors.name: Umayyad Caliphate
successors.text: the Garamantian kingdom of the Fezzan, roughly 180,000 km2 on the Garamantes page, taken by Uqba ibn Nafi

ledger.x: 500 BCE (approx.): the Garamantes are the people of the Fezzan oases around Garama.
c.150: the Garamantes become a major power.
666: Uqba ibn Nafi takes the Fezzan for the caliphate.

wars.name: Roman expeditions against the Garamantes (19 BC, 50 AD)
wars.outcome: Raids without a lasting border change: 'Lucius Cornelius Balbus and other Romans captured fifteen of their settlements in 19 BC'; the Fezzan page names 'Septimus Flaccus in 19 BCE and Suetonius Paulinus in 50 CE' for the 'small-scale military expeditions'.

wars.name: War of Oea and Leptis Magna
wars.outcome: 'In 69 AD the Garamantes would support Oea against Leptis Magna'; no change of border recorded.

wars.name: Septimius Severus's capture of Garama
wars.outcome: 'In 202 AD, Septimius Severus captured the capital city of Garama.'

wars.name: Arab conquest of the Fezzan
wars.outcome: The Garamantian kingdom falls to Uqba ibn Nafi: Germa and Waddan taken in the 660s ('Battle of Germa (663)' in the Uqba page's infobox; Waddan '46 AH / 666 CE' in its text; the conquest page puts the Germa operation around the 666/7 raids).

certainty.note: Oasis-centred polity in the Sahara: no frontier is described on any page; the 180,000 km2 figure is an area, not a boundary.
